title: Normal force at O
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force at point O as 5mg using Newton's second law and energy conservation.

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly determines the electric field strength as mg/(5q) using force balance and energy conservation at point B.

title: Final kinetic energy
description: Essential: Correctly computes the kinetic energy upon return to the parabola as (68/45)mgR using projectile motion and energy conservation.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy correctly for the first quadrant to find speed at O.

title: Force balance at B
description: Important: Sets up Newton's second law at point B (mg - qE = mv_B^2/R) recognizing the electric force direction.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important: Correctly models the motion from B as projectile motion, relating horizontal and vertical displacements to time.

title: Parabola coordinate relation
description: Important: Uses the parabolic equation y = x^2/(2R) to relate coordinates when the ball returns to the track.

title: Sign error in electric force
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns direction to the electric force (e.g., qE added to mg) at point B, leading to wrong E or v_B.

title: Centripetal force misapplication
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong radius or misapplies centripetal force formula at O or B (e.g., forgetting normal force or weight).

title: Unit or algebraic mistake
description: Pitfall: Makes algebraic errors in solving simultaneous equations or omits units in final answers where required.
